subject: Reseller addendum: revenue-share / pass-through language discussion
messages:
From: Legal - CloudBazaar <legal@cloudbazaar.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: partner-ops@cloudbazaar.com
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: reseller addendum — revenue share / pass-through language

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the recent conversations — CloudBazaar is excited to get Redwood listed in our marketplace. Before we finalize, our procurement/legal team asked us to confirm a couple of items in the reseller addendum:

- We need explicit pass-through of chargebacks and refunds in accordance with our reseller model.
- Revenue-share timing: we currently require monthly gross-to-net reconciliation within 30 days after month-end.
- We prefer the partner paper approach that references "Marketplace Terms" with pass-through pricing to be enforced on our platform.

I've attached our template (CB_Marketplace_Terms_v1.docx) for your redline. Can your legal team confirm if Redwood will accept pass-through billing and provide suggested language for net/gross definitions?

Thanks,
Maya Chen
CloudBazaar Legal
legal@cloudbazaar.com

Attachment: CB_Marketplace_Terms_v1.docx (docx)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Date: 2026-02-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reseller addendum — revenue share / pass-through language

Hi Maya — thanks, and excited to move forward. Looping in our sales and legal lead.

Quick context for your team: Redwood's hosted billing typically invoices customers directly; for marketplace pass-throughs we need to ensure (1) a clean definition for "revenue" vs "charges", and (2) that our Order Form ties the billing flow to the marketplace pass-through so finance can reconcile.

Karthik / Marissa — can you review CB's template and propose a Redwood-friendly redline addressing (a) pass-through mechanics, (b) gross vs net definition, and (c) reporting cadence? We'll then send to CloudBazaar legal for counter.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-19T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reseller addendum — revenue share / pass-through language

Vanessa / Marissa — quick commercial/ops notes from my side:

- Pass-through billing is operationally OK but requires explicit statement that Redwood will invoice CloudBazaar (or end-customer) and that refunds/chargebacks processed by CloudBazaar will be netted on the following settlement period.
- Need to avoid language that makes Redwood liable for CloudBazaar's failure to collect. Recommend clause: "Partner will remit to Redwood gross Marketplace receipts less returns, refunds and chargebacks, subject to a monthly reconciliation process. Redwood will not be liable for amounts not collected by Partner unless Redwood materially contributed to such non-collection."
- Reporting cadence: monthly statements + 30-day dispute window.

I'll defer to Marissa for legal wording/redline.

-Karthik
Sr. Director, Marketplace Partnerships
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-19T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: reseller addendum — revenue share / pass-through language

Vanessa / Karthik — attached is a proposed redline and a clean Order Form snippet we can surface to CloudBazaar. Key edits: 

1) Defined terms: "Marketplace Receipts" = gross consideration actually received by Partner from end users for Redwood services sold through Partner's marketplace, excluding taxes collected on behalf of authorities.
2) Pass-through mechanics: Redwood will invoice Partner monthly for Redwood-owed amounts; Partner shall remit within 30 days after receipt of the invoice. Refunds/chargebacks processed by Partner will be deducted on the next settlement cycle; Partner shall provide supporting documentation for any reductions.
3) Liability carve: Redwood is not responsible for Partner's failure to collect, except where Redwood materially prevented Partner's collection (e.g., service outages causing billing errors).
4) Audit & reporting: Partner to provide monthly reconciliation report via SFTP or shared Drive link; Redwood to provide dispute notice within 30 days.

See attached: RBW_Partner_Paper_redline_20260219.pdf and OrderForm_CloudBazaar_v2.docx. I flagged a couple of places where CloudBazaar might push for "net of refunds" vs our suggested "gross receipts less refunds" — that will be the negotiation point.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Partnerships
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: RBW_Partner_Paper_redline_20260219.pdf (pdf), OrderForm_CloudBazaar_v2.docx (docx)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-20T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: RBW redline for marketplace addendum

Hi Maya — forwarding our redline for the marketplace addendum (see attached PDF). High level: we can accept a pass-through model but need the definition of Marketplace Receipts and an operational reconciliation cadence (monthly + 30-day dispute).

Two asks for your legal team:
1) Please review Marissa's redline and confirm whether CloudBazaar will accept the proposed liability carve and monthly reconciliation.
2) Clarify the revenue reporting format (CSV / SFTP) and whether CloudBazaar can provide a sample settlement report we can test against finance.

If you prefer a short call to resolve open points, happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Vanessa

Subject: Re: RBW redline for marketplace addendum

Hi Vanessa / team,

Thanks for the redline — appreciate the clarity. Our counsel has two substantive counterpoints and an updated redline attached:

1) Gross vs Net: CloudBazaar requests the language state settlements are "calculated on gross Marketplace Revenue, net of refunds and taxes, as defined in Partner's reporting system." We prefer to limit the definition of returns/chargebacks so it aligns with our billing system.
2) Liability: we cannot accept a carve that leaves us fully responsible for refunds; instead we propose a shared-liability clause where Redwood will accept chargeback responsibility only if (a) incorrect product configuration or (b) a confirmed platform defect attributable to Redwood.

Attached: CB_counter_redline_v2.pdf with inline comments. Also attached a sample settlement CSV for your finance team to review (sample_settlement_Feb.csv).

If helpful, happy to do a 30-minute call Thursday to align.

Regards,
Maya Chen
CloudBazaar Legal
legal@cloudbazaar.com

Attachments: CB_counter_redline_v2.pdf (pdf), sample_settlement_Feb.csv (csv)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Legal - CloudBazaar <legal@cloudbazaar.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-23T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RBW redline for marketplace addendum — agreed next steps

Team — appreciate the quick turnaround. Summary of agreed approach after internal review: 

- Definition: adopt CloudBazaar's wording for gross Marketplace Revenue, net of refunds and taxes, but require Partner to produce a monthly CSV report in the sample format CloudBazaar sent.
- Liability: accept shared-liability carve. Redwood accepts responsibility only where Redwood's confirmed platform defect or mis-configuration caused the chargeback; otherwise, Partner bears collection risk.
- Reconciliation cadence: monthly settlements, Redwood to raise disputes within 30 days of receipt.
- Operational next steps: CloudBazaar to accept our redline with the agreed edits; then we will circulate a final Order Form and route for signature.

Action items: 
- CloudBazaar legal: confirm acceptance in writing and sign the attached addendum.
- CloudBazaar ops: provide SFTP credentials or shared Drive link for settlement files; continue to use sample_settlement_Feb.csv format.
- Redwood finance: once signed, Jordan and Karthish (cc'd) to set up the pass-through accounting in our billing system.

I'll prepare the final addendum for signature and send a DocuSign link by EOD Monday. DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&PowerFormId=abcdef

Thanks all — moving to close.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
